recommendation: Preferred source candidate for an Akeru-owned minimal WASM frontend evaluation, not an approved runtime or port.
observations: README.md explicitly lists Freedoom Phase 1 and 2 and libretro input/savestates.
Makefile lines 310-314 provide an Emscripten static bitcode target; a browser frontend and final linking remain necessary.
README.md declares GPL v2 and COPYING contains GPL v2 text; this is a repository claim, not a full per-file dependency audit.
Makefile.common enumerates libretro-common and optional FluidLite/Vorbis/Ogg; WANT_FLUIDSYNTH defaults to 0.
README.md documents bundled engine resource WAD and additional game formats; source compatibility is not permission to package those game data.
recommendedEvaluationConstraints: Pin this source revision; initially evaluate HAVE_THREADS=0 and WANT_FLUIDSYNTH=0 to bound thread and soundfont dependencies. These settings are a proposal, not a tested recipe.
Use only separately selected Freedoom data. Do not copy commercial IWADs, demo game payloads or prior binaries.
Inventory exact compiled dependencies, resource WAD source/credits and frontend/toolchain before distribution.
Confirm a useful allowed local FreeDM mode independently; Phase 1/2 support does not establish bot/deathmatch feasibility.
remainingSourceAudit: Per-file engine and libretro-common terms, embedded prboom_wad_data.h resource provenance, optional audio implementation notices, frontend dependency chain and complete corresponding source.
